notes.title: 2.27 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Update Notes:
Adjustment: Fish tank upgrade capacity increased from +2 to +3 per level.
Improvement: Feeding area now dynamically scales on ultra-wide screens.
Optimization: Decor collision detection improved.
Fix: Resolved an issue where overusing the Tomato Timer could cause negative values.

notes.title: 2.26 Updates
notes.notes:
Update Tips
-Optimize background music playback, add white noise one-key mute switch
-Added the function of using a large number of tomatoes
-Add the function of exiting automatic archive
-Added the function of copying fish continuously

notes.title: 2.25 Update Notice
notes.notes:
New Feature: Added up/down, left/right, and flip functions for decorations.
Adjustment: Improved auto-hide functionality with auto-display for UI elements.
Fix: Resolved an issue where the volume slider UI could go out of bounds.
Adjustment: Feeding XP values now align with submarine feed XP values.
Improvement: White noise settings are now automatically saved, eliminating the need to reconfigure upon next launch.
Update Notes:

New Feature: Added decoration editing functions, including zoom in/out, rotation, and flip.

Fix: Resolved the issue of repeated purchases for background images.

Other: Miscellaneous bug fixes.

notes.title: Update Notes:2025-2-24-2
notes.notes:
Fix: Resolved the issue of submarines disappearing.
Adjustment: Updated food appearance, now changed to a star shape.
Adjustment: Updated the visual design of the card-drawing interface.

notes.title: Update Notes 2025-2-23
notes.notes:
- New fish tank background system: Instead of repeated purchases, each background is now a one-time permanent purchase per tank.  
- Main UI icons have been updated.  
- Tomato Timer rewards increased from 10 to 30, and small clock rewards increased from 5 to 10.  
- Fish currency adjusted: Base value changed from 1, now scales with the level of the fish.  

Thank you for your feedback! If you encounter any issues, please share your thoughts in the community. Your input is invaluable!

notes.title: 2024-10-20 Demo Update 🐟🎮
notes.notes:
2024-10-20 Demo Update 🐟🎮

Fish Management Interface: Added the option to view specific fish🐠, allowing quick access when clicking.
Fish Selling Interface: Added default sorting and color-based sorting options🎨.
Selling Lag Issue: Optimized the lag that occurs when selling fish🚀.
Music Player: Added single-track loop and random loop options, along with fixing a few minor bugs🐛.
Other Improvements: Fixed several bugs and enhanced the overall experience🔧.

If you have any feedback or suggestions regarding this version's optimizations, feel free to leave a comment below—thank you!

notes.title: 🌟 Hello everyone, welcome to Lofi Aquarium! 🌊
notes.notes:
Come see what exciting new things we have for you!

Lofi Aquarium is your desktop cultivation and work companion tool. There’s already a lot of info out there, but to celebrate the upcoming New Product Festival, we've made some awesome updates and unlocked new features. Check out what's new:

🎏 Name Your Fish
– Ever wanted to give your fish a unique name? Name them after a friend, or even rename important tasks as fish! 🐟✨

🎁 Big Rewards for Previous Test Participants
– Thank you for your support! Enjoy more colorful fish coins, goldfish coins, and other exciting rewards! 🏅🎨

🐠 Increased Tank Capacity to 50
– We've increased the default tank capacity to 50! If you participated in the initial test, you'll notice this exciting improvement! 🐡💦

-bobo
2024.10.14

notes.title: The Demo Version is Officially Released—Hope You Enjoy It
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45082830/9ceece8799a8c8d9d44c96ea978013f29b593800.png[/img]
Hello everyone! We’re excited to share the demo version of Lofi Aquarium. In this version, you can experience the core gameplay. If you purchase the full version, you'll unlock even more content!

🎮 The demo includes: 🐟 20 fish
🏞️ 3 backgrounds
🐠 1 standalone aquarium
🎵 All music and white noise
🕹️ All the basic gameplay from the full version!

We hope you enjoy it!
